papers.title: A novel approach to fabricate Si3N4 by selective laser melting
papers.first_author_affiliation: Tallinn University of Technology, Ehitajate 5, 19086 Tallinn, Estonia

corresponding_authors.name: Marina Aghayan
corresponding_authors.affiliation: FACT Industries, Õismäe tee 124, 13513 Tallinn, Estonia

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及Si3N4陶瓷的选择性激光熔化制备，虽属增材制造范畴，但未涉及生物医学植入物的应力遮蔽、疲劳或骨整合等核心问题。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on LPBF of Si3N4 ceramic without any biomedical context, stress shielding, fatigue testing, or osseointegration considerations.

summary_zh.motivation: 探索Si3N4陶瓷在选择性激光熔化中的可制造性
summary_zh.method: 采用SLM工艺参数优化制备Si3N4样品
summary_zh.result: 成功制备出致密Si3N4陶瓷，验证了该方法的可行性
summary_zh.validation: 通过微观结构和力学性能测试验证

summary_en.motivation: To explore the feasibility of fabricating dense Si3N4 ceramic parts using selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Optimized SLM process parameters were used to fabricate Si3N4 samples.
summary_en.result: Dense Si3N4 ceramic components were successfully produced, demonstrating the viability of the approach.
summary_en.validation: Microstructural characterization and mechanical testing confirmed the quality of the fabricated parts.

papers.title: Selective laser melting of ink-printed (SLM-IP) copper (Cu) nanoparticles (NPs) for facile controllable fabrication of super-hydrophobic surface
papers.first_author_affiliation: State Key Laboratory of Robotics and System (HIT), Harbin 150001, PR China

corresponding_authors.name: Junyan Liu
corresponding_authors.affiliation: State Key Laboratory of Robotics and System (HIT), Harbin 150001, PR China

corresponding_authors.name: Yang Wang
corresponding_authors.affiliation: State Key Laboratory of Robotics and System (HIT), Harbin 150001, PR China

llm.relevance_to_user: 与用户研究方向无关，涉及铜纳米颗粒的激光熔融制备超疏水表面，不涉及生物医学植入物或力学性能。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address biomedical implants, stress shielding, fatigue, osseointegration, or mechanical testing relevant to AM biomedical materials.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发可控制造超疏水表面的方法。
summary_zh.method: 采用选择性激光熔融结合喷墨打印铜纳米颗粒。
summary_zh.result: 成功制备了超疏水表面并调控润湿性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过接触角测量和表面形貌表征验证。

summary_en.motivation: To develop a facile method for fabricating controllable super-hydrophobic surfaces.
summary_en.method: Selective laser melting of ink-printed copper nanoparticles was used.
summary_en.result: Super-hydrophobic surfaces with tunable wettability were successfully fabricated.
summary_en.validation: Contact angle measurements and surface morphology characterization were performed.
